home.demandsLead: Line items, quantities, scope and time left are public. Buyer name, specifications and documents are for members only, under the sealed-bid rule.

home.showcaseTitle: Is your product in the showcase?
home.showcaseLead: Publish your products with price and minimum order details so buyers can find you and send inquiries. The showcase is open on the free plan too.
home.seoParagraph: Rothern is a B2B marketplace that lists products from manufacturers, distributors and service providers in Turkey with price and minimum order details, and matches buying requests with sealed-bid quotes. Product and company profiles are public; a free account is needed to quote, request information and see buyer details.
home.metaTitle: B2B marketplace: products, suppliers and buying requests
home.metaDescription: Browse verified suppliers' products with price and MOQ, talk to companies, and send sealed-bid quotes on buying requests. Buyer and seller in one account. Signing up is free.
